description_en: Queries the commands that you created or the common commands that Alibaba Cloud provides
description_zh: 查询您手动创建的命令或者阿里云提供的公共命令
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-commands --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --command-id c-sh02yh0932w0000 --name testName --provider AlibabaCloud --type RunShellScript --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2bti7cf70000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCommands

parameters.help_en: The command name. Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 命令的名称，暂不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The provider of the common command. Take note of the following items:

If you set this parameter to `AlibabaCloud`, all the common commands provided by Alibaba Cloud are queried.
If you set this parameter to `User`, all the custom commands created by you are queried
parameters.help_zh:
公共命令的提供者。参数值的具体说明如下：

当该参数取值为`AlibabaCloud`时，查询由阿里云提供的所有公共命令。
当该参数的取值为`User`时，查询由您创建的所有自定义命令
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the command. Valid values:

RunBatScript: batch command, applicable to Windows instances
RunPowerShellScript: PowerShell command, applicable to Windows instances
RunShellScript: shell command, applicable to Linux instances
parameters.help_zh:
命令的语言类型。取值范围：

RunBatScript：适用于Windows实例的Bat命令。
RunPowerShellScript：适用于Windows实例的PowerShell命令。
RunShellScript：适用于Linux实例Shell命令
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The tag key of the command. A tag key can be 1 to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 命令的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the command. A tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 命令的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that are bound to the command
parameters.name: tag
